mapper.insert: INSERT INTO card (id, name, cate, annual, pre, corp) VALUES (card_seq.nextval, #{name}, #{cate}, #{annual}, #{pre}, #{corp})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM card ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO brand b USING ( SELECT #{id} AS id, #{visa} AS visa, #{master} AS master, #{bc} AS bc, #{amex} AS amex FROM dual ) src ON (b.id = src.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET b.visa = src.visa, b.master = src.master, b.bc = src.bc, b.amex = src.amex WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, visa, master, bc, amex) VALUES (src.id, src.visa, src.master, src.bc, src.amex)
